achievement_ember_in_a_minute_title.note: The name of a badge the player earns, shown by the store. Short, like a trophy's name. The ember is the glowing goal at the top of the level; the player climbs to it carrying a lantern.

achievement_ember_in_a_minute_descriptio.note: One plain sentence under the badge's name that says how to earn it: reach the ember in under 60 seconds. Keep the number 60.
